clip-roast-beans: Coffee beans move under rotating paddle in a round metal roasting/cooling machine.
Physical coffee-bean preparation and supply-stage context.
No weighing, purchase, delivery, bean origin, unit cost or inventory value established.
clip-steam-milk: Hands hold stainless pitcher under espresso-machine steam wand; pitcher moves and is removed.

No milk amount, wage, labor cost, waste or time-per-order measured.
clip-pour-milk: Barista pours milk from metal pitcher into paper cup, then handles white lid over cup.

clip-cafe-tables: People sit around several tables; a person walks through central aisle and patrons talk or gesture.

No order throughput, long dwell times, rent, profit or cash shortage established.

clip-espresso-extract: Chrome portafilter spouts in close view; espresso forms and flows into cup later; final frame moves toward cup.
Equipment and coffee extraction, including visible start of flow.
